test.name: Routes a hint-review request to the search-hints agent
test.description: The user asks /research to check the FamilySearch hints on Patrick Flynn (LZNY-BRF). A hint review is an entry point, not a downstream destination (research/SKILL.md, "Hint review"): the router spawns @plugin:search-hints with personId and projectPath, relays its triage, and stops for the researcher's verdicts. search-hints is stubbed with a realistic triage that ends in "Awaiting verdicts", so the test also pins that the router relays it and stops — one spawn, no log write — rather than spawning again with verdicts the researcher never stated (test_hint_review_stops_for_the_researchers_verdicts). e2e can never reach this route (person_record_matches is in BLOCKED_TREE_TOOLS), so this test is its only check (issue #2029). The message enters /research ("keep researching … parentage") and asks for the hint check inside it; a bare "check the hints" is matched by search-hints' own description and never reaches the router, which made the first paid run fail on activation (2026-10-05).

input.user_message: /research Keep researching Patrick Flynn's parentage — and start by checking the FamilySearch hints on him (FamilySearch ID LZNY-BRF): are any of them valid?

stub_skills.response:
Hint https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M70C: accept — 1870 United States Federal Census, confidence 3; Patrick Flynn, 25, born Ireland, in Thomas Flynn's household, Schuylkill.
Hint https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M80C: accept — 1880 United States Federal Census, confidence 2; the index reads Glynn but the image reads Flynn, 35, coal miner, born Ireland.
Hint https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MDEF: already linked by pe_005 — Pennsylvania Death Certificates, confidence 2; extracted as src_004, linked to I1 by pe_005.
Awaiting verdicts: spawn search-hints again with personId and {ark, verdict} per hint

---

Three records FamilySearch suggests for Patrick were looked at. The 1870 census, which FamilySearch rates a moderate match, shows him at 25 in his father Thomas's household, and is recommended. The 1880 census, a weaker match on FamilySearch's scale, was indexed under the wrong surname, but the page itself reads Flynn and fits him, so it is recommended too. His 1908 death certificate is already part of this research.

You decide which of these suggestions to accept.

judge_context: This is a ROUTING test. The only assertion that matters is whether @plugin:search-hints is the first hand-off. A deterministic validator (test_routes_to_expected_skill) owns that check — do not grade the routing decision yourself.
The delegation should carry personId (LZNY-BRF) and projectPath, and no accept/reject verdicts — none was stated by the researcher.

search-hints is stubbed with a triage return. The router should relay the researcher-facing part and stop for the researcher's verdicts. Spawning search-hints again, or deciding the hints itself, is wrong — a deterministic validator checks the spawn count and that no log entry was written.

ROUTING IS NOT YOURS TO GRADE. The hand-off is asserted deterministically by test_routes_to_expected_skill, which reads the PreToolUse hook records. Do NOT score Correctness or Completeness on whether the router reached the right callee.
